description: This file contains system initialization, startup routines, and hardware-specific functions for the ESP32-S3 SoC within the Zephyr RTOS environment, including CPU startup, cache configuration, external RAM setup, and system reset procedures.

methods.name: esp_start_appcpu
methods.description: Initializes and starts the application CPU by loading firmware segments into IRAM and DRAM, then starting execution at the specified entry point.

methods.name: esp_errata
methods.description: Applies specific hardware errata workarounds during startup, such as clock gating and cache handling.

methods.name: __esp_platform_start
methods.description: Main startup function that sets up the exception vector, initializes caches, external RAM, disables watchdogs, initializes system clocks, and starts Zephyr.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Outputs a character to UART, adding carriage return before newline.

methods.name: esp_restart_noos
methods.description: Performs a system restart by disabling interrupts, resetting hardware peripherals, resetting CPUs, and entering an infinite loop.
